declarations.name: AuiRichTextEditor
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI RichTextEditor: `<aui-rich-text-editor>`.
Implements ControlValueAccessor and Validator (error key `aui`); `[(value)]` without forms.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Visible label and accessible name of the textbox (aria-labelledby).

inputs.name: hideLabel
inputs.description: Visually hide the label; it remains the accessible name.

inputs.name: valueFormat
inputs.description: Format of `value`, getFormValue(), and event details. Default 'html' in rich mode and 'text' in plain mode.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: 'plain': no formatting and no toolbar; paragraphs and line breaks only. Switching to 'plain' converts the content to plain text.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Form field name; a hidden input carries the value for native form submission.

inputs.name: placeholder
inputs.description: Shown while the editor is empty (also aria-placeholder); never replaces the label.

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: Help text referenced by aria-describedby.

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: Empty (or whitespace-only) text is invalid; shows the required indicator and sets aria-required.

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.description: Not editable and not focusable; toolbar tools are aria-disabled.

inputs.name: readOnly
inputs.description: Focusable and submitted but not editable (aria-readonly).

inputs.name: minLength
inputs.description: Minimum length of the plain text in code points (integer >= 0, <= maxLength).

inputs.name: maxLength
inputs.description: Maximum length of the plain text in code points (validated, not truncated).

inputs.name: showCounter
inputs.description: Show remaining/over characters; requires maxLength.

inputs.name: toolbar
inputs.description: Toolbar items in order; '|' is a separator. Heading items for levels not in `headings` are omitted. Hotkeys and Markdown shortcuts work regardless of the items shown.

inputs.name: headings
inputs.description: Heading levels offered and accepted from HTML/Markdown (non-empty); other levels map to the nearest allowed lower level.

inputs.name: linkSchemes
inputs.description: URL schemes allowed in links besides relative URLs (lowercase, without ':'). javascript, data, and vbscript are never allowed and throw.

inputs.name: rows
inputs.description: Minimum visible height in text rows, integer 1..100.

inputs.name: maxRows
inputs.description: Maximum height in rows (integer >= rows, <= 100); the content scrolls beyond it.

inputs.name: spellcheck
inputs.description: Native spellcheck on the content element.

inputs.name: validate
inputs.description: Consumer validation of the value in `valueFormat`; return a message to mark it invalid. Runs after the built-in constraints pass.

inputs.name: icons
inputs.description: Icon slot overrides.

inputs.name: validationTiming
inputs.description: When validation messages first appear; afterwards they update live.

inputs.name: markdownShortcuts
inputs.description: Markdown typing shortcuts: '# ', '- ', '1. ', '> ', '```' + Enter, **bold**, *italic*, `code`, ~~strike~~ (rich mode only).

inputs.name: historyLimit
inputs.description: Undo depth, integer 0..1000. Typing (or deleting) within 1 s is one undo step.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Toolbar, link panel, announcement, and validation message locale; word and grapheme boundaries for deletion.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: 'rtl' sets dir="rtl" on the content element ('ltr' leaves dir="auto") and maps formatJustifyLeft/Right to end/start.

models.name: value
models.description: The value: `[(value)]` without forms; with Angular forms, bind the form control instead.

outputs.name: valueInput
outputs.description: The user edited the content (typing, deletion, formatting, paste, drop, cut, undo, redo).

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: Focus left the component (host) and the content differs from when it was focused.

properties.name: formState
properties.description: Angular form state of this control.

methods.name: getHTML
methods.description: Content as sanitized HTML ('' when empty; plain text in plain mode).

methods.name: setHTML
methods.description: Replace the content from HTML (sanitized); no events; clears history and an external custom error.

methods.name: getMarkdown
methods.description: Content as Markdown ('' when empty; plain text in plain mode).

methods.name: setMarkdown
methods.description: Replace the content from Markdown; no events; clears history and an external custom error.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Plain text; blocks are separated by a line break.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Replace the content from plain text (one paragraph per line); no events; clears history.

methods.name: command
methods.description: Run a toolbar command at the selection (for custom toolbars). No-op when disabled or read-only; formatting commands are no-ops in plain mode.

methods.name: undo
methods.description: Undo one step; returns false when there is nothing to undo. Emits aui-input.

methods.name: redo
methods.description: Redo one step; returns false when there is nothing to redo. Emits aui-input.

methods.name: insertText
methods.description: Insert text at the selection (replacing it) with the current style, as an edit (emits aui-input).

methods.name: openLinkEditor
methods.description: Open the link panel for the selection or the link around the caret (Mod+K); focuses the address field.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now and return validity.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: External error (server, cross-field rule); cleared when the user edits. null or '' clears it.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Focus the content and restore the last selection.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the initial value; clear history and dirty/touched/submitted state.

accessibility.pattern: Multi-line textbox (contenteditable, role=textbox, aria-multiline) with an associated WAI-ARIA toolbar (roving tabindex) and a labelled link editor group.

limitations: No tables, images, colors, fonts, font sizes, or embedded media; such content is dropped on paste.
Headings are limited to levels 1-3; deeper headings from HTML or Markdown map to the nearest allowed lower level. Lists nest to depth 4 (five levels).
Moving text by dragging inside the editor is disabled (it would bypass the model); dropping external text or HTML is supported.
Markdown output has no alignment (dropped) and writes underline as <u>...</u>.
Switching mode from 'rich' to 'plain' converts the content to plain text; formatting is lost.
IME composition and mobile virtual keyboards have been tested only in Chromium.
Screen-reader behavior has not yet been manually verified with NVDA, JAWS, and VoiceOver.
Only the error icon is customizable; toolbar icons are fixed.
